transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came because my family and friends keep telling me the bank papers show nothing was taken, but I know they’re hiding my money. It’s been going on for over a year. They use things like bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to cover it up. I need someone to listen, because I keep confronting them and they still won’t tell the truth.
Have you tried to prove your belief to others or taken any steps to address this situation?

Yes. I keep trying to show people what’s happening. I’ve looked at the bank papers, but they keep saying those prove nothing was taken. I don’t believe that. For over a year I’ve been telling my family and friends they’re hiding my money, and I keep confronting them about the bills, the fundraisers, the trip plans—all the things they use to cover it up. I feel like I have to keep pushing until they finally tell the truth.
Have you ever experienced anything unusual, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don’t seem to notice?
No, I don’t think so. I don’t hear voices or see things like that. It’s more what I know is happening with my money, not seeing or hearing stuff.
Can you tell me if there's anything else you believe others are doing to you or if your concerns are mainly about your money being hidden?

It’s mainly about my money. I mean, that’s the thing I know is happening. My family and friends keep saying the bank papers show nothing was taken, but I don’t believe that. For over a year they’ve been hiding it and using things like bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to cover it up. That’s why I keep confronting them, because I need them to finally tell the truth.
Do you think it’s possible that your family and friends are not hiding your money, even though they’ve shown you bank papers that indicate nothing was taken?

No, I don’t really think that’s possible. They keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I know they’re hiding my money. It’s been going on for over a year, and the bills, the fundraisers, the trip plans… those are part of how they cover it up. I have to keep confronting them until they tell the truth.
Have you ever had any other beliefs that others don’t seem to share or understand, outside of the situation with your money?

No, not really outside of that. It’s just this thing with my money. They keep acting like I’m wrong because of the bank papers, but I know they’ve been hiding it for over a year, using bills and fundraisers and trip plans to cover it up. That’s what people don’t seem to understand.
Have you ever had any other strong beliefs that something is happening that others don’t seem to recognize, even if they’ve tried to explain it differently to you?

No, it’s still mainly the money. I know I’ve said it already, but that’s what’s happening. They keep telling me the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I don’t believe that. For over a year they’ve been hiding it, using bills and fundraisers and trip plans to make it look normal. I just want them to stop lying and tell me the truth.
Even though your family and friends have shown you bank papers that indicate nothing was taken, why do you continue to believe so strongly that your money is being hidden?

Because the papers don’t explain what I know has been happening. It’s been over a year, and I can see how they keep moving things around, talking about bills, fundraisers, and trips like that makes it all normal. But to me it looks like a cover-up. They keep saying nothing was taken, but I don’t believe them. That’s why I keep confronting them—I need them to finally tell the truth.
Even though your family and friends have shown you bank papers that indicate nothing was taken, do you think there's any possibility that they are being honest and that your money hasn't been hidden?

No, I don’t really think that’s possible. I know they keep pointing to the bank papers, but those papers don’t change what I’ve seen for over a year. They’re hiding my money, and all this talk about bills, fundraisers, and trips is just how they cover it up. That’s why I keep asking them and confronting them. I need them to finally tell me the truth.
Even though there is no evidence of your money being hidden and others have shown you bank papers that prove nothing was taken, why can’t you accept their explanation?

Because those papers don’t match what I know has been going on. For over a year I’ve seen them cover it up with talk about bills, fundraisers, and trip plans, like that explains where everything went. I can’t just accept it when I know they’re hiding my money. That’s why I keep confronting them—I need them to tell the truth.

Even though there is no proof supporting your belief and others have shown you bank papers that show nothing was taken, why do you think your belief is more accurate than what the documents and your family and friends are telling you?

Because I’ve been seeing it happen for over a year. The papers just don’t explain it to me. My family and friends keep saying nothing was taken, but then they talk about bills, fundraisers, trips, all these things, and it feels like that’s how they’re covering where my money went. So I trust what I’ve been seeing more than those papers. I have to keep asking them until they tell me the truth.

Do you believe that the way your family and friends are hiding your money is happening through normal, everyday actions like managing bills or planning trips, or do you think they’re using something more unusual or supernatural?

No, not supernatural. It’s normal things, like bills and fundraisers and planning trips. That’s how they cover it up. They keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I’ve known for over a year they’re hiding my money. That’s why I keep confronting them—I need them to tell the truth.
Even though there is no evidence supporting your belief and everyone tells you the bank papers show nothing was taken, do you think your belief could be wrong?

No, I don’t think I’m wrong. I know everyone keeps saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but that doesn’t change what I’ve been seeing for over a year. They’re using things like bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to cover it up. That’s why I keep asking them about it—I need them to tell the truth.
